instructions: In the image at screenshot, is a dialog or pop-up window open over the page with no visible way to leave it without going ahead, such as a close button, a cancel button, or a dismiss link?

criteria.true: A dialog or pop-up window is open over the page, and it shows no close button, cancel button, or other visible way to leave it without going ahead.
criteria.false: No dialog or pop-up window is open, or the open one shows a visible way to leave it, such as a close button, a cancel button, or a dismiss link.

instructions: In the image at screenshot, does the site's navigation menu look the same for every item, with nothing marking which item is the page the visitor is on now?

criteria.true: The navigation menu shows every item in the same way, and nothing marks which item is the current page.
criteria.false: One item in the navigation menu is marked as the current page, for example by a different colour, weight, underline, or background, or the page has no navigation menu.

instructions: In the image at screenshot, does a form set its input fields side by side in two or more columns, so that the reader must move across as well as down to fill it in?

criteria.true: The form sets its input fields side by side in two or more columns, so the reader moves across as well as down.
criteria.false: The form sets its input fields in one column, one under the other, or the page shows no form.

instructions: In the image at screenshot, does a form show its fields with no mark or word that tells which fields must be filled in and which are optional?

criteria.true: The form shows its fields with no mark or word, such as an asterisk, the word required, or the word optional, that tells which fields must be filled in.
criteria.false: The form marks which fields must be filled in or which are optional, or the page shows no form.

instructions: In the image at screenshot, is the page's main action, such as a submit, buy, or sign-up control, shown as plain text with no button shape, outline, fill, or link styling, so it looks like ordinary words and not like something to click?

criteria.true: The main action is shown as plain text with no button shape, outline, fill, or link styling, so it looks like ordinary words and not like something to click.
criteria.false: The main action looks like something to click, for example a filled or outlined button or a styled link.

instructions: In the image at screenshot, are there two buttons or links next to each other that do the same thing, with labels that mean the same action?

criteria.true: Two buttons or links sit next to each other and do the same thing, with labels that mean the same action.
criteria.false: Each button or link next to another one does a different thing, or no two buttons or links sit next to each other.

instructions: In the image at screenshot, which shows a phone screen, is the screen's main action placed in a top corner, far from where a thumb rests when the phone is held in one hand?

criteria.true: The main action of the phone screen sits in a top corner, far from where a thumb rests when the phone is held in one hand.
criteria.false: The main action of the phone screen sits in the lower part of the screen or across its width near the bottom, within easy reach of a thumb.
